title: Patch labeling scene with click-to-pick
description: 'A scene that can be used to label the various patches of a quadlayout' and 'click on a patch and see all of its labels'. Scaffold PatchLabelScene (id patch-label, extends ModelScene) with `uv run ixdar-cli new-scene`; it loads a saved layout .dsl (CRAW-4) and its labels (CRAW-6). Add ray->triangle picking to ModelScene (screen point -> Camera3D ray -> face id; none exists today), map face -> patch via patch_id, highlight the picked patch through HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.setTags/setTagColor while the other patches keep QuadLayoutRuntime patch colouring, and show the patch's labels in the scene menu. Terminal commands `label <name> [parent]` and `unlabel <name>` act on the current selection (multi-select with shift-click); `save-layout` writes labels back through PatchLabelsDslWriter. Expose selection and labels in AutomationRuntime.uiState so ixdar-cli ui-state can assert them. Related: VIEW-4 (click-to-zoom on tag region) and VIEW-5 (tagged rendering pipeline) are in progress on the tag-based viewer; reuse their zoom-to-region and tag colouring rather than adding parallel code, and extend them to patches.
definition-of-done: 1. patch-label scene id exists with launch.json entry; loads a saved layout and shows labels. 2. Clicking a patch highlights it and lists its labels; shift-click accumulates. 3. label/unlabel terminal commands mutate PatchLabels and save-layout persists them. 4. ui-state includes selectedPatches and their labels. 5. Picking is allocation-free per frame (reusable vectors) and ignores clicks over the menu panel. 6. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. run-scene --scene patch-label --keep-alive with the saved plane layout; `ixdar-cli click` at a patch centre projected via orbit-get; `ui-state` shows one selected patch. 2. `ixdar-cli type 'label thumb'` then `ui-state` shows the label; `save-layout` then reload shows it persisted. 3. Screenshot with a highlighted patch for the ticket record. 4. Unit test for the ray->triangle intersection helper on a hand-built triangle.
